items.subject: EVIDEX Pilot Pack Request - BrightStart Community Trust
items.recommended_action: Route to Evidex pilot pack and request approved non-sensitive evidence intake.
items.next_step: Qualify the lead, approve evidence intake, generate the controlled pilot pack, then gate delivery on review and payment state.
items.body: Replying to your Evidex ad. We need a donor-ready evidence pack for a community reading and food support pilot. The evidence is scattered across KPI notes, attendance registers, receipt summaries, field visit notes, and photo logs. We need a clean evidence table, mapped claims, provenance, narrative support, QA receipt, and delivery ZIP. The sample is controlled and non-sensitive. Please send the intake/payment path.
